notes: 24 ABI functions plus the receive/fallback reviewed (Uniswap V2 Router02, solc 0.6.12). The 9 swap variants and getAmountsIn/Out share UniswapV2Library.getAmountsIn/Out and _swap / _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens; one of each read in full, the rest by structure ('same as swapExactTokensForTokens'). Loops: 4 explicit (getAmountsIn's downward 'while idx', getAmountsOut, _swap, _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens), all whiles (two copies of the last one rotated as 'while True'). Implicit: 12 copies (return arrays, the pair-swap bytes, one memcpy; P7). P11 counts the implied second 'assert s + 1 < len' of each path loop (the first assert is needed: it fires when path is empty and len - 1 wraps). No semantic error found (checked sortTokens/pairFor, getAmountOut/In formulas with SafeMath, the fee-on-transfer balance logic, the WETH deposit/withdraw paths).
summary: Faithful, all 4 loops present; the fee-on-transfer loop is printed as 'while True' wrapping the function's tail, and after the first allocation calls and revert reasons become raw memory.
